text:
jen: Heads-up — release cut is blocked by CI. ci-pruner job is leaving a stale lockfile and there's a partial artifact in the registry, causing e2e extract to fail. Can we triage?

deploy-bot: Pipeline 5801234567 failed on job `ci-pruner` (<https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/5801234567|logs>)

alex: Oof. Release window in ~45m. Any quick mitigation? @samir

samir: I've seen this before. pruner sometimes leaves `/tmp/pruner.lock` when the runner gets SIGKILL. If the multipart upload never does the final commit you end up with a truncated blob that e2e can't extract.

samir: Two paths: re-run the pruner/upload job (best-effort) or pin/promote the last-good artifact digest and cut manually.

maya: Pin sounds safer if re-run isn't guaranteed. We need to confirm backward compatibility for the pinned build.

jen: If re-run looks flaky, prefer pin->promote->smoke->cut. Pin candidate digest: `sha256:abc123` (last-green)

samir: Quick commands:
```
# re-run only the failing job on the same pipeline
cicd rerun --job ci-pruner --pipeline 5801234567 --node node-7

# manual promote fallback
deploy-bot promote --artifact redwood/api@sha256:abc123 --env prod --tag temp:release-hold
```

alex: I'm going to trigger the rerun now. @samir can you watch logs? :thumbsup:

samir: watching. tailing runner logs.

deploy-bot: Re-run initiated by alex: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/5801234567/runs/2

samir: log excerpt — multipart commit shows 2/3 parts committed, final commit missing:
```
upload: part 1 ok
upload: part 2 ok
upload: part 3 failed: socket hangup
commit: aborting multipart, leaving temp blob
```

samir: rerun completed and failed again; lockfile recreated. Looks like the runner is getting preempted on node-7.

maya: Given the window, we should pin. Rebuild might take too long.

jen: Decision: Hold the cut for 20m while we try one more quick recovery. If that fails, pin to `sha256:abc123` and promote. I'll notify PM/sales.

alex: Rerun started (attempt #3) with CLEANUP=true.

samir: attempt #3 failed same symptom. Moving to manual promote.

samir: Running promote command now.
```
deploy-bot promote --artifact redwood/api@sha256:abc123 --env prod --tag temp:release-hold
promote: success -> prod tag updated to redwood/api@sha256:abc123 (temp:release-hold)
```

jen: Promoted to `sha256:abc123`. Smoke on staging passed (basic e2e). Holding for final verification, will cut in ~12m unless regressions.

maya: I'll draft a short release note: "Pin to last-good build due to CI multipart upload failure; full rebuild in hotfix branch." Will attach to the cut PR.

alex: ACK. I'll monitor the canary post-cut.

jen: Summary: reruns failed due to pruner/runner preemption -> manual promote to last-good digest `abc123` -> smoke passed -> cut scheduled after final verification. Updating release channel and changelog now. :white_check_mark:
